framework_reference: Krämer et al., Five-Dimensional Assessment Framework
assessment_subject: FIBEMATE v3.3.0 — Post-Quantum Cryptography Full-Stack Engineering Platform
novelty: First empirical application of CARS framework to a real running PQC engineering project

ml_dsa_65_fml_dsa.verification: 84/84 self-test, KeyGen KAT 75/75, Noble bidirectional cross-validation

protocols.opk_prekey: TLA+ formal verification, 3 invariants (O1/O2/O3), one-time consumption

notes.strength: Complete and quantifiable — every algorithm has KAT results, benchmark data, TVLA reports
notes.weakness: No automated asset scanner; partial third-party implementations (SLH-DSA WASM, Noble ML-KEM-1024)
notes.cars_feedback: CARS assumes 'documented inventory' is enough; FIBEMATE's KAT/Bench/TVLA/TSR evidence exceeds expectations → suggest adding 'verifiability' sub-dimension

double_ratchet_dh_layer.method: PQ_REKEY_INTERVAL=100 adjustable; P-256→other requires code change

message_encryption.method: AES-GCM hardcoded; message-gm.js supports SM4 switch

signature_algorithms.method: SM2 hardcoded in gm.js, verification logic coupled

ntt_domain_params.method: q=3329 compile-time constant; parameter change requires recompilation

algorithm_agility.hot_swap_architecture: FIBEMATE has no pluggable algorithm registry. gm.js:183 negotiateWithServer() is application-layer negotiation, not an algorithm registry.
algorithm_agility.agility_is_low_but_rationale: As an 'executable textbook', demonstrating each algorithm independently is more valuable than runtime switching. FIBEMATE's agility is in side-by-side comparison (ML-KEM vs SM2, fml-dsa vs SLH-DSA), not runtime replacement.
algorithm_agility.cars_feedback: CARS Algorithm Agility assumes a production system needing runtime migration. Suggest adding 'cross-algorithm comparison capability' as a supplement for education/verification projects.

lifecycle.distribution: OPK pre-key protocol (one-time upload, one-time consumption)
lifecycle.destruction: Session reset / OPK state machine consumed→burned

formal_verification.c2_handshake: TLA+ 7 invariants verified (incl. K3 strong key independence)

notes.strength: OPK protocol has full TLA+ formal verification; ephemeral key pattern avoids reuse
notes.weakness: Re-key interval (100 messages) lacks quantitative security derivation; no key expiration alerts; no audit logging
notes.cars_feedback: CARS Key Lifecycle focuses on 'does the org have a key management policy'. FIBEMATE uses TLA+ formal proofs instead of written policy — this is stricter. Suggest adding 'formal verification' as a Key Lifecycle bonus.

double_ratchet.reason: P-256 fixed, ML-KEM re-key interval adjustable

message_encryption.reason: AES-GCM hardcoded, SM4-GCM fallback path exists

tls_integration.reason: No standard TLS integration; application-layer custom protocol

protocol_coupling.design_rationale: FIBEMATE deliberately stays away from standard TLS 1.3 — showing how hybrid KEM works at application layer is more educational than patching OpenSSL.

notes.strength: Each protocol component independently testable; IANA #4590 format compliance
notes.weakness: No cipher suite negotiation; zero forward compatibility; no interop testing
notes.cars_feedback: CARS Protocol Coupling assumes standard protocol (TLS/SSH) usage. FIBEMATE's educational decoupling trades standard compliance for pedagogical clarity. Suggest distinguishing 'protocol standards compliance' from 'educational transparency'.

license_compliance.evidence: GPL-3.0-only + SPDX all files + BOM 3-layer governance

automated_dependency_scanning.note: Dependabot not enabled; npm audit 11 vulnerabilities unaddressed

known_limitations: Pure JS implementations are not constant-time
No hardware side-channel countermeasures (software TVLA only)
RTL source code withheld pending security review

notes.strength: Security documentation system complete; CI/Nightly all green; OpenSSF passing badge
notes.weakness: Bus Factor=1 (hard wound); zero third-party audit; dependency scanning missing
notes.cars_feedback: CARS Organization Readiness assumes multi-person team. FIBEMATE meets multi-person standards in docs/CI/SBOM but Bus Factor=1 exposes fundamental difference. Suggest adding single/small-team adjustment factor.

improvement_roadmap.item: Quantitative derivation of key rotation interval

cars_framework_feedback: Algorithm Agility dimension does not fit education/verification platforms — suggest 'cross-algorithm comparison capability' sub-dimension
Key Lifecycle dimension misses formal verification bonus — TLA+ model proofs are stricter than written policy
Protocol Coupling dimension does not distinguish 'standards compliance' from 'educational transparency' — application-layer custom protocols may be intentional design
Organizational Readiness dimension lacks single/small-team adjustment factor — Bus Factor=1 but docs/CI/SPDX-complete case is unscorable
methodology_note: All scoring data sourced from FIBEMATE public engineering data (CI logs, KAT results, TLA+ models, security docs, source structure). No new tests were run — all data existed at lock commit f465fba (2026-08-01). This is the first empirical application of the CARS framework to a real running PQC engineering project.
